notes: τὰ πάντα is split with the supplied nominal *things* on the article under rule 102 and *to all* on the adjective; putting the whole *to all things* on πάντα under rule 17 is the competing reading, and rule 102 scopes rule 17's generic-noun clause to anarthrous Greek.
The case preposition *to* stays with πάντα because the ASV writes the article no determiner for it to anchor (rules 21, 23); REV.11.15's article-carried *of* had a determiner beside it.
Both τοῦ before participles take *who* under rule 90; τοῦ before θεοῦ is `unrepresented` because the frame's *the* belongs to ἐνώπιον, which is rule 95's REV.14.10 shape.
ζῳογονοῦντος heads on *giveth*, realizing the compound's verbal head; the unit note records the competing head on *life*.
